name: Hall of Fair Warnings
narrator_line: Three cheerful signs line the corridor, and each one says TRAP louder than the last.
read_aloud: Three cheerful signs line the corridor, and each one says TRAP louder than the last. Halfway along, a man in a net turns slowly upside down and waves, which only makes him spin. He calls out that his name is Dale and that you should avoid the square tiles.

positions.name: None worth naming; the hazard is the floor.

map.layout: A clean, well-lit corridor about 100 feet long, caution tape on both walls and a row of ever-louder TRAP signs; Dale Pruitt hangs upside down in a snare net halfway along.
map.cover: None worth naming; the hazard is the floor.
map.hazards: Welcome Mat pressure plates and a swinging WET FLOOR sign (check values in 00-overview.md section 5.4).

encounters.our_name: Hall of Fair Warnings: Read the Signs

voice_lines.intro: Three cheerful signs line the corridor, and each one says TRAP louder than the last.
voice_lines.twist: A plate clicks under somebody's shoe and a WET FLOOR sign swings out of the wall like it has been waiting all day.
voice_lines.win: Dale is down, upright and very grateful, and he has already offered to carry things.
